title: PESA, Fifth and Sixth Schedules
quote: Scheduled Areas = Fifth = TAC = PESA; Tribal Areas = Sixth = District/Regional Councils

boxes.title: Fifth Schedule: Governor & TAC
items: Area declared by ==**President**== in consultation with Governor
Governor reports **directly to the President**, annually
**Para 5**: may direct any Act **does not apply**; regulations need **President's assent**
TAC (**Paragraph 4**): ==**not more than 20**==, about **three-fourths** ST MLAs

boxes.title: Sixth Schedule councils
items: ADC: up to **30** members: **4** nominated, **26** elected; **5 years**

items.what: **Samatha v. State of AP**: tribal land to private miners **void**

boxes.title: PESA: Gram Sabha powers
head: Subject
Power
rows: ST member elected by Gram Sabha, not Sarpanch
